root: ^ to see if the legends about Maerimond were true.
^I found more than I bargained for.
^I leave this note beside a poor skellie —
^ likely a bandit from an age long past—
^ Steel won't scratch them — only blunt weapons like axes stand a chance.
^And beware the light pillars scattered throughout.
^ Each one lit strengthens these accursed guardians.
^ Embrace the darkness if you value your life.
^If you're foolish enough to press on,
^ As for me, I've had enough.
^ I'm getting out while I still can.
